description.value: Browns Socialhouse is a Vancouver-based Canadian franchise with over 80 locations, positioning itself as a blend between a neighbourhood pub and upscale casual dining. The Surrey - Panorama location at 15260 56th Ave sits along the Highway 10 corridor and offers fresh, flavourful food in a stylish, relaxed setting with outdoor seating. It is a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the south Surrey area.
